title: Shipping Allowance on Home-Delivery Transition Supplies (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a home-delivery transition supply carries a shipping allowance for the time the shipment takes. The allowance is read from the shipping method on the member's latest shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy order of the drug.

| Shipping method of the latest shipped order of the drug | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| cold-chain shipping | the standard shipping time of the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy program, in business days, added as that number of days |
| standard shipping | **2** days |
| any other method, or no shipped order of the drug | none |

The allowance is added to the supply before the supply is held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

*Hypothetical.* Suppose the member's program has a standard shipping time of 4 business days. If the latest order of the drug went cold-chain, 4 days are added. If it went by standard shipping, 2 days are added, whatever the program's standard shipping time.
